name: What is the process for getting a stair repair estimate from Frasheski Construction?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for getting a stair repair estimate from Frasheski Construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: To get a stair repair estimate from Frasheski Construction, you can contact us to schedule an on-site consultation. During this visit, our team will thoroughly inspect your stairs, assess the damage, discuss your concerns, and review potential repair options. We will then provide you with a detailed, no-obligation quote that outlines the scope of work, estimated timeline, and cost. Having clear photos of the damage ready can be helpful during the initial contact, but an in-person assessment is essential for an accurate estimate.
